parameters.description_en:
The remediation setting ID. To specify multiple IDs, separate them with commas (,).

For information about how to obtain a remediation setting ID, see [ListRemediations](~~270772~~).
parameters.description_zh:
修正设置ID。多个修正设置ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取修正设置ID，请参见[ListRemediations](~~270772~~)。
